name: saas-app-shell
title: SaaS App Shell
description: A SaaS application skeleton: inset sidebar shell with grouped navigation, a dashboard page (stat summary cards, interactive visitors chart, searchable members table with recoverable empty state and undoable archive toast), and a sectioned settings page. Routing is left to the consumer; views switch via local state.
